scenes.text: This tutorial covers Activation maps. Inspect the image regions that most influence a trained computer-vision classifier.
Open Activation maps from the Results and quality control section. Select a trained vision model and representative object crops from classes of interest.
In the main configuration area, choose the attribution method, target layer, target class, channels, normalization, and sampling.
Before the full run, review the visible settings and use a preview or test mode when one is available. compare maps across correct, incorrect, high-confidence, and low-confidence examples.
When the workflow finishes, activation overlays and attribution measurements help assess whether the model learned biologically plausible cues.
